implemented: Generic AnchoredSpec placement validates finite geometry, flips the preferred side and clamps within the current surface viewport; no global coordinate or desktop identity inference.
Tooltip content is paint-only. The generic runtime uses one cancellable dwell deadline and ordinary frame callbacks for active motion, without a new polling worker.
One explicit Popover focus scope supports scoped control keys and wheel input, outside-press dismissal, reachable opener restoration and current-anchor/capture retirement.
Multiline geometry, overlay admission and clipboard authority share one optional current CPU scene; clipboard requests and completions validate the admitted field and exact native lifetime.
Tray descriptions/overflow and closed-dock application labels use generated semantic recipes, while hint buffer room stays separate from input coverage and reserved display area.

visual_acceptance.scope: Reviewed offscreen software-Vulkan fixtures, distinct from actual native tooltip pixels, frame pacing, memory and generic popover acceptance.

compact_dock_regression.scope: Existing targeted offscreen dock comparison; no native reopen, input or RSS claim.

release_deployment.scope: Desktop and CLI replacement only, followed by native readiness and stable supervisor checks. This deployment report does not establish settings inode identity across deployment; the separate pointer acceptance checks exact state during its own workload.

scoped_frame_counter_evidence.scope: Both surfaces submitted zero additional frames in their two-second settled samples. RPC sampling missed the early dwell window and visible-scene progression; these counters establish neither precise dwell/fade duration nor smoothness, scanout, long idle or general zero repainting.

dock_empty_hint_band_pointer_leave.scope: The pointer entered a hit-free part of the dock buffer and the native client reported pointer leave; this does not establish bar click-through.

observations: Bar and dock labels are fully visible with readable contrast, rounded shape and clear spacing.
Each label is absent after pointer leave.
Bar capsule geometry, dock placement and wallpaper remain coherent in the reviewed captures.
private_screenshot_human_review.limits: Static captures do not establish fade timing or shape over time, smoothness, scanout, other palettes/densities, hardware or generic popover behavior.

exact_settings_bytes_inode_artifacts_cli.scope: Exact settings bytes/inode, wallpaper/source/theme export hashes and identities, initially empty clipboard/history/helper state, UI state, monitor/workspace and the supplied running process are preserved during the pointer-only acceptance workload. No settings, clipboard offer, lifecycle or monitor operations are performed by that helper.

native_acceptance.initial_clipboard_scope: Initially empty selection; history and its helper state remained unchanged. No clipboard transfer or third-party GUI application interoperability claim.

generic_popover.scope: The pointer-only production tooltip helper does not exercise the standalone popover client.

precise_dwell_fade_timing_and_smoothness.reason: RPC sampling missed both the early dwell window and visible-scene frame progression. The source tokens are dwell 0.5 seconds and enter 0.16 seconds; these are configuration values, not measured durations.

docs_site.scope: Five local validation steps at the recorded evidence revision; final published-head CI and Pages deployment remain separate.

performance.scope: Frame counters from a short tooltip interaction cannot establish current process RSS, GPU completion, scanout latency, idle CPU, sustained pacing or a resource improvement.

limits: One popover scope per surface; native xdg_popup roles, nested menus and secure-session behavior are outside this contract.
Native generic popover focus/keyboard/outside-dismiss/clipboard interoperability remains separate from local behavior fixtures and production tooltip testing.

Native static label visibility and pointer leave are reviewed, but precise dwell/fade timing, animation smoothness and scanout remain unmeasured. A bar clock can legitimately submit frames outside the observed two-second settled sample.
Current resource targets, physical/hardware GPU behavior, multi-output/hotplug/fractional native acceptance and broader launcher/tray requirements remain open.
Complex-script shaping, bidirectional layout, font fallback and preedit/IME remain open; accessibility remains deferred by user request.
Prior Notes native acceptance and CPU measurements retain their own source revisions and scopes; this milestone does not relabel or extend those results.

delivery.scope: PR77 delivery only. Original validation, native tooltip/static scope and pending timing/resource/popover limits retain their own source revisions; this does not publish Weather.
